Commentary.Commentary: We're back and so are the players on the ground. Alex Hales and Philip Salt are the openers for England. Mohammad Nawaz to bowl the first over. Here we go again...
... CHASE TIME ...

England bowled with a lot of planning and discipline. Moeen Ali led his boys well and rotated his bowlers smartly. Liam Dawson and Adil Rashid did a great job to stifle the Pakistan batters while the pacers were also brilliant. The tourists will be backing themselves to chase down this total and make it 3-1. Let's see if they succeed.

Once again the batting of Pakistan was all about the opening partnership between Mohammad Rizwan and Babar Azam. They added 97 runs but the kind of impetus they needed never came. It was a laboured knock from Mohammad Rizwan, especially in the second half of the innings and despite his strike rate being 131.34, the hosts didn't benefit much.

A couple of biggies from Asif Ali in the last over and Pakistan have managed to post a decent total on the board. Considering that it's the same pitch where Pakistan chased down a target of 200 without breaking a sweat, the target looks below par at this stage. Has the nature of the pitch changed? Did it become slow in the second half? We will find out in the second innings.
SIX! Smoked! Fuller in length, around off, it's in the slot. Asif clears his front leg and launches it over long on for a biggie. Pakistan end on 166 for 4.
Another full toss from Topley, outside off, Nawaz forces it down to long off, just a single.
Slower one, a dipping full ball around off, Ali drives it through extra cover for a run.
SIX! A biggie off a hat-trick ball. Full toss on middle, Asif flexes his muscles and dispatches it over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
Mohammad Nawaz has come to bat now.

OUT! TAKEN! Another slower one, a low full toss outside off, Rizwan tries to pump it over mid off but gets no timing on his lofted shot. Alex Hales makes no mistake this time inside the ring. Reece Topley is on a hat-trick now.
Commentary.Howout: c Alex Hales b Reece Topley

Commentary.Commentary: Asif Ali is in next. The batters had crossed so Mohammad Rizwan will be on strike.

OUT! CAUGHT! Slower one, full and outside off, Khushdil Shah aims for a heave across the line but is early into his shot. It takes the top edge and Moeen steps back from extra cover to take the skier safely.
Commentary.Howout: c Moeen Ali b Reece Topley

Commentary.Commentary: Reece Topley to serve the final over of the innings.
Yorker around off, Shah steps back and squeezes it out to point for a run.
Too full and around leg, Rizwan moves back and knocks it down to long on for one.
Fuller in length and on middle, Shah whips it to deep mid-wicket and opens his account with a single. 150 comes up for Pakistan.
Khushdil Shah arrives. Can he inject some momentum?

OUT! LBW! Willey spears it in, very full and around middle, Masood gets across the stumps and tries to heave it over the leg side but misses. He is rapped on the back leg, the appeal is made and the finger goes up. Stone dead. Willey smiles as Shan returns without even thinking about the review.
Full toss on middle, Masood goes down and slogs it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
A low full toss around leg, Rizwan walks forward and pushes it to long off for a run. The 50-run stand comes up, off 39 balls.
David Willey to bowl the penultimate over.
Very full and around leg, Rizwan moves back and tries to dig it out. It takes the bottom edge and goes to deep backward square leg for a run.
Short again, around off, Masood pulls it to deep mid-wicket and finds the fielder. Only a run.
FOUR! Here comes a boundary. Short and down the leg side, slower in pace, Masood waits and pulls it in the gap at backward square leg for a boundary.
Spears in a full ball on off, reversing a bit, Rizwan leans across and works it to deep mid-wicket for a single. Pakistan need boundaries at this stage.
Full toss on middle, clipped to deep square leg for one.
Slower length ball around off, Rizwan heaves it to deep square leg for a single.
Olly Stone is back on.
Short and on off, pulled to deep square leg for a single. Only 7 runs from the over.

The physio comes out. Mohammad Rizwan is struggling a bit after his dive on the fourth ball of this over. He's back on his feet now. Strong man. We all know how he had spent two days in a hospital ICU bed before the semi-final against Australia during the last T20 World Cup.

A cutter, on a length and wide outside off, Masood throws his bat at it and gets a bottom edge. It rolls to the keeper. Salt collects and throws it at the stumps at his end. The ball ricochets to point and they cross.
Another couple off a mistimed shot. Fullish and around off, Masood drags it to deep mid-wicket. Rizwan dives to complete the second run and is looking winded.
Follows the batter down the leg side with a shortish delivery, Masood swings his bat at it and gets it away off the inner edge. The ball goes to mid-wicket and they run hard to take two.
Slower again, short and outside off, Rizwan stays back and drags it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Play and a miss! Slower one, around off and a bit on the shorter side, Rizwan comes down the track and tries to pull but misses.
Reece Topley is back to bowl at the death. 2-0-16-0 are his figures so far.
Another full toss, around off, Rizwan goes down and paddles it to fine leg for a run.
Full toss, outside off, Shan steps back again and has to chase it. He pushes it to extra cover and gets just a run.
Wide! Sliding down the leg side, on a length, Shan steps back and tries to heave but misses.
Too full and on middle, Rizwan forces it back towards the bowler. Willey dives and parries it to mid on. They get one.
FOUR! Drilled down the ground! Full in length around off, Rizwan wears his skates as he charges down and bludgeons it down the ground for a boundary. Nice and straight.
A dipping low full toss on off, Masood goes back and eases it to wide long on. Calls for two but gets only a run.
Fuller in length around leg, Rizwan whips it over square leg for a single.
David Willey is back on.
Fuller and on off, Rizwan sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a run. End of an economical evening for Adil Rashid.
Short and on off, turning in, Masood steps back and punches it to long off for one.

PUT DOWN! Floated and full, around leg and turning away as it's a googly, Masood tries to play the slog sweep but gets a top edge. Alex Hales drops a sitter at long on, running to his left, and the batters get two.
Loopy and full around off, Rizwan sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Sharp delivery, short and outside off, turning away, Rizwan goes down and tries to pull but misses.
Advances down the track to take it on the full but inside-edges his attempted heave to wide long on. Easy two.
Adil Rashid to bowl out. 0 for 20 so far.
Slower one, a touch short and around leg, Masood is deceived as he tries to work it around the corner. He is hit on the body.
A low full toss on middle, Rizwan works it to deep square leg and picks up a run.
Olly continues to bowl short, outside off, Masood stands tall and drags his pull shot through mid-wicket. A single is taken.
Short and outside off, Rizwan pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Spears it in very full, on leg, Rizwan flicks it to deep square leg for two.
FOUR! Finds the gap! Short in length around off, angling in, Rizwan stays back, swivels and pulls it to the deep backward square region for a boundary.
Change in bowling. Olly Stone is back on. 0 for 18 in his 2 overs so far.
Follows the batter down the leg side with a full toss, Masood plays a mistimed flick shot. It rolls towards mid-wicket and they collect a couple. Given as leg byes.
Very full again from David, around off, Rizwan forces it down to long on for one.
Short in length, around leg, Masood moves back to make room and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Too full and around off, Rizwan squeezes it out to short third man and steals a single.
Drifting down the leg side, Masood tries to flick but misses. It goes off his pads to the on side and they cross for a leg bye.
Short and on off, Masood steps back and punches it through the line. Not much timing though and it goes to covers.
David Willey is back on. He went for 12 runs in his opening over.

Interesting from Shan. Full and flighted, around off, Masood attempts to play the reverse sweep. It takes his gloves and loops in the air. Falls safely behind the keeper and they cross. 4-0-32-1, Liam is done with his spell.
Shan Masood is in next at number 3.

OUT! Babar holes out! Dawson delivers it short and on middle, at 90 mph, the pressure is there to increase the scoring rate, so Babar goes on the back foot for the pull shot. He keeps it uppish and gets caught at deep mid-wicket by Ben Duckett. The timing was not there as it came from the lower half of his blade.
Commentary.Howout: c Ben Duckett b Liam Dawson

Commentary.Commentary: A long hop around off, Rizwan goes on the back foot and pulls it to deep mid-wicket. Again a run.
Quicker and fuller on middle, Babar clips it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Again the length is short, Babar goes back and cuts it to deep point for a single.
Short in length and wide outside off, Rizwan cuts it to deep point for a single.
A single down to long off to close the off. Pakistan are looking to up the ante now.

SIX! Against the spin but it's gone over the fence, by just. Loopy again, full and around off, turning away, Mohammad Rizwan skips down the track and clobbers it towards long on. Will Jacks attempts to take the catch and throw the ball back in play as he is over the line but fails. A good attempt.
Flatter and on off, punched down to long off for one.
Uppish but safe! Loopy and full around off, once again Rizwan tries to play the slog sweep but gets a top edge. It drops at mid on and they cross.
Tossed up, on middle, fuller in length, Rizwan tries to slog but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Flighted and full, wide outside off, Babar reaches out and strokes it to long off for a single.

Drinks break. England remain wicketless but they won't mind the current rate of scoring much. It's a batting beauty and Pakistan will have to score more quickly in the second half to reach somewhere near 200.
Fires it short and flat on middle, Mohammad Rizwan goes back and eases it to wide long on for two. FIFTY FOR RIZWAN! The crowd rejoice.
Skidding in around leg, Babar tucks it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Mistimed! Rizwan is foxed in flight. He jumps down the track early and then has to check his shot. He plays it in the air but the ball falls in no man's land at mid off. They cross.
Quicker through the air, full and on middle, it's worked through mid-wicket for one.
Floated delivery, full and around off, Babar wrists it gently through square leg and scampers back for the second run.
Delivers it flat and on the pads, Rizwan helps it to short mid-wicket and crosses for a run.
Liam Dawson is back for his third over. 0 for 18 so far.
Very full this time, Rizwan fetches it from outside off and sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Turning away from around off, Rizwan goes back and taps it down to backward point.
Loopy one, full and around off, Rizwan shapes up for the sweep shot but then guides it to short third man.
Quicker one, around off, punched down to long on for a single.
Short and around off, Babar rocks back to pull but ends up mistiming it back to the bowler.
Flatter and fuller on off, Rizwan scuffs his attempted slog sweep down to long on. One run.
Very full and outside off, Rizwan drives it to mid off and pinches a single. A good over for Pakistan.
Uses the angle of the bowler and nudges a length ball through wide mid on. A single is taken.

FOUR! Boom! Willey comes from 'round the angle and digs it in short, around off, Babar goes on the back foot and pulls it delightfully in front of square on the leg side. It races away to the fence in no time.
FOUR! Lovely touch! A length ball around off, angling away, Babar gets close to the line and dabs it down past the diving short third man fielder for a boundary.
A dipping yorker outside off, Rizwan pushes it back past the bowler to long on for a single.
Serves it full and around leg, the batter works it to deep square leg for a single.
Change in bowling. David Willey has a new role to fulfil in the middle overs.
Flatter and on middle, Rizwan whips it down to wide long on where the fielder makes a diving stop. Saves two runs.
Adil drags his length short again, around middle, Rizwan uses the crease and hits it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Quicker through the air, short and around leg, Rizwan goes back and pulls it to deep square leg for one.
A touch short and on off, Babar goes on the back foot and punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Sliding down the leg side, Rizwan helps it behind square leg for a run.
Too full in length around off, Babar forces it down to long on for a single.
Adil Rashid comes into the attack.
Delivers it on a good length, around off, Babar gets back and turns it in front of square on the leg side for a run. At the end of the Powerplay, Pakistan are comfortably placed at 52 for no loss.
Angling in around middle, it's clipped to deep square leg for one.
On a length around off, tapped down to backward point. Rizwan wanted a run but sent back.

Caught off a Free Hit! A length ball down the leg side, Babar heaves it over square leg and Dawson takes the catch in the deep. He doesn't realize it's a Free Hit and takes his time before returning the ball. Only a run, still.
Short this time, on middle, Rizwan pulls it to deep backward square leg for a single. It's called a no ball for overstepping, Free Hit coming...
FOUR! Superb shot! A full toss on middle, Rizwan shows the full face of his bat and caresses it back past the bowler for a boundary down to long on.
Fullish and angling down the leg side, Babar tries to flick but fails to middle properly. It deflects off the inside edge and then the pads to square leg. The batters cross.
Change in bowling. Olly Stone to deliver the final over of the Powerplay.
Steps down the track and works it wide of the mid-wicket fielder. Two runs.
Flighted around off, Rizwan plays the conventional sweep but it goes towards mid-wicket. Dot.
FOUR! Premeditated but excellent execution. Full and floated, around middle, Rizwan goes down and across and unveils a cute paddle sweep. The short fine leg fielder chases but in vain.
Walks forward and flicks a full ball to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter and on off, Babar punches it back and Dawson dives across to his left to parry it towards the cover fielder.
FOUR! Poor line and length. Short and wide outside off, Babar rocks back and slaps it through point for a boundary.
Back to spin again. Liam Dawson returns to bowl his second over.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Reece digs it in short but it's down the leg side, Mohammad Rizwan turns inside the crease and pulls it down to fine leg for a boundary.
Full and on the pads, Azam flicks it to deep backward square leg for another run.
Shortish and on off, Rizwan goes back and pulls it behind square leg. The fielder mops it up in the deep and they cross.
Angling away on a length outside off, at 136 kph, Rizwan plays a crunching drive but finds the short cover fielder.
Delivers it on a length around middle, slower in pace at 122 clicks, Rizwan works it through square leg and scampers back for the second run.
Lands it on a length around off, shaping in, Rizwan pushes it off the inner half to mid on.
Back of a length, on middle and leg, Babar tucks it through square leg and the ball races away. It's stopped near the fence and the batters take two.
A 141 kph short delivery, around off, Babar sways away from the line.
Goes short and on middle, at 143 kph, Rizwan pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Angling into the batter, on a fuller length, Rizwan flicks it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Well played! Width there outside off, short in length, Mohammad Rizwan stays back and uses the pace of the bowler to guide it wide of short third man for a boundary.
Full and straight, it's eased away through square leg for a single.
Debutant Olly Stone to bowl the third over.
On a good length around off, Rizwan defends it off the inner edge and it deflects off his pads to point.
FOUR! Finds the gap! Fuller in length and wide outside off, Mohammad Rizwan gets on the front foot and crunches it through the gap at covers.

Swing and a miss! Topley delivers it on a good length outside off, Rizwan flashes his bat at it but fails to connect. There is some late swing as it goes past the batter and Philip Salt does well to collect it to his left. A big smile on his face.
Lands it on a fuller length around middle and off, Rizwan presses forward and works it off the inner portion to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Off the inner edge! Topley serves it full and around leg, Rizwan tries to flick again but it takes the inside edge and races down to fine leg for a boundary.
A bit of swing there for Topley. He pitches it up and around leg, Rizwan leans across to flick but misses.
Reece Topley to bowl from the other end.
Flighted and around leg, Rizwan again jumps down the track and knocks it down to long on for a run. A good positive start from Pakistan.
Around middle and leg, flatter through the air, Babar nudges it towards square leg and steals a single, his first of the game.
Loopy around off, Rizwan uses his feet and works it through square leg for a single.
Tossed up, full and on middle, defended back.
FOUR! Rizwan is away in style! Dawson goes full but this time the line is on middle and leg, Rizwan goes down and sweeps it firmly through backward square leg for a boundary.
Flighted delivery, full and around middle, Rizwan defends it to the off side.

All in readiness now! The umpires are on the field and so are the players. Mohammad Rizwan and Babar Azam are the openers for Pakistan. It's a jam-packed stadium again and the atmosphere is electric.​ Liam Dawson to bowl the first over. Here we go...
Did you know? This is Pakistan's 200th T20I - they are the first to reach this mark.

Pakistan (Playing XI) - Mohammad Rizwan (WK), Babar Azam (C), Shan Masood, Iftikhar Ahmed, Khushdil Shah, Mohammad Nawaz, Asif Ali (In for Haider Ali), Usman Qadir, Haris Rauf, Mohammad Hasnain, Mohammad Wasim (In for Shahnawaz Dahani).

England (Playing XI) - Alex Hales (In for Dawid Malan), Philip Salt (WK), Will Jacks, Ben Duckett, Harry Brook, Moeen Ali (C), David Willey (In for Sam Curran), Liam Dawson, Adil Rashid, Olly Stone (In for Mark Wood), Reece Topley.
Toss - Moeen Ali has won the toss and ENGLAND ELECT TO BOWL FIRST!

England are in a happy space currently. They are taking this series as a chance to finetune the grey areas and are also trying a few new combinations. The new crop has not let them down, and the progress of Harry Brook, Ben Duckett and Will Jacks has been incredible. Mark Wood's sensational return in the last game bolstered the English bowling, and they have immense potential despite missing a few key players. The tourists are looking more stable compared to the home team and will be looking for a 3-1 lead before heading to Lahore.
